aboutH2: Centres for Health and Healing: A Lakeside Retreat in Vaughan
intro: Centres for Health and Healing (CFHH), experience a luxurious retreat-style sanctuary, complete with a private indoor swimming pool, outdoor lounge, multiple alfresco seating areas, and exclusive lake views. The gated entrance ensures the utmost privacy and security for clients. CFHH employs a non-12-Step approach to treatment, recognizing that not everyone’s values align with the traditional 12-Step program. The center emphasizes mental health, mindfulness, and a blend of evidence-based and holistic therapies, while offering individual and group counseling sessions for enhanced connections and bonding.

pillars.title: Nestled within the Canadian Countryside
pillars.body: The Centres for Health and Healing boasts a picturesque lakeside location in Vaughan, Ontario, encompassing 110 acres of serene Canadian countryside. The secluded oasis offers privacy, rest, rejuvenation, and enjoyment of the blissful natural surroundings. The dedicated team of nurses, counselors, interventionists, case managers, and professional chefs work collaboratively to create tailored and effective treatment plans for each client.

pillars.title: Addressing the Root Causes of Addiction
pillars.body: CFHH prioritizes addressing the underlying factors of addiction, including mental health disorders, trauma, and personality disorders. By concentrating on mental health, they treat addiction at its core, effectively transforming behaviors, thought patterns, and expectations, alongside prescribed medications when necessary. The center also values family involvement, offering a family group program every Saturday to foster support, care, and education as crucial components of lasting recovery.

pillars.title: Cutting-Edge, Evidence-Based Treatment and Tranquil Activities
pillars.body: Centres for Health and Healing is a technology-friendly facility, catering to working professionals and parents. They request clients to be technology-free for the first week, but are open to making flexible arrangements.

overviewH2: Centres for Health and Healing - Center Overview
overview: Settled on 110 acres of farmland, Centres for Health and Healing offers a holistic and non-12 step treatment approach and a variety of water activities. Vaughan Recovery House (now called Kirby Estate Recovery Centre) is one of two addiction treatment centres run by Centres for Health and Healing (CFHH). This is a residential addiction rehab centre offering detox and primary care in a relaxed, intimate and homely setting. Tackle alcoholism, drug addiction, concurrent disorders, depression and other issues in a safe and nurturing environment, where each client can follow their own personalized treatment plan with 24/7 dedicated and professional support. Our private, residential facility is set in a quiet, gated community for the security and privacy of our clients. With just 16 beds, we provide a cosy, home-from-home feel, with a communal TV lounge/group room, fully equipped kitchen and dining area, gardens and sports
serviceCaption: 11 services · as listed by the centre
afterOverview: Most clients stay 30 days, which is the minimum admission at Kirby Estate, and some extend to 45, 60 or 90 days when they need more time in residence. The week runs on a set schedule six days a week, with psychoeducation and process groups, one-on-one counselling, small group work, family therapy and mindfulness. Rooms are semi-private by default because the team finds that sharing helps people keep working through things in the evenings, though a private room can be arranged for an extra fee when one is free. When you finish, CFHH sets up an aftercare plan that runs for up to 12 months and can connect you with professionals closer to home, in the GTA or wherever you live.

steps.title: A typical week at Kirby Estate

items.label: One-on-one counselling
items.body: Regular private sessions with your counsellor or psychotherapist to get at what drives the drinking or drug use.

items.label: Process & psychoeducation groups
items.body: Group sessions where you learn how addiction works and talk it through with others in the house.

items.label: Small group therapy
items.body: Smaller groups using CBT and DBT skills for cravings, stress and relapse.

items.label: Saturday family program
items.body: Family members join a group every Saturday to learn how recovery works and how to help.

items.label: Yoga, meditation & fitness
items.body: Time set aside each day for yoga, meditation, the gym and walks around the lake.

location.heading: Centres for Health and Healing in Vaughan, Ontario
location.intro: CFHH's Kirby Estate house sits on a gated 110-acre property on Kirby Road in Vaughan, in York Region just north of Toronto. Most families drive in: downtown Toronto is about 45 minutes away, Pearson airport about 25 minutes, and Barrie or Hamilton roughly an hour.

faqIntro: Answers come from the centre's listing and its own website. Still unsure? Call, it's free and confidential.

faqs.q: How much does Centres for Health and Healing cost?
faqs.a: Although treatment costs can fluctuate based on factors such as program length and insurance benefits, the average price is typically around $23,000. The cost of treatment at Centres for Health and Healing (CFHH) depends on various aspects, including the chosen program, the duration of the stay, and the required care level. To obtain the most precise and current pricing details, it is advisable to get in touch with CFHH directly. Their well-informed team can discuss your unique needs, offer comprehensive pricing information, and help you explore any financial assistance options or insurance coverage that might be accessible to you.

faqs.q: How long is treatment at CFHH?
faqs.a: Residential stays start at 30 days, and CFHH also offers 45, 60 and 90 day programs. Clients follow a set schedule six days a week that mixes group therapy, one-on-one counselling, family therapy and mindfulness.

Yes. CFHH has full medical detox on site at its Vaughan house, with medical and therapeutic staff on hand 24 hours a day. The centre says detox usually takes three to ten days, depending on the substance and how heavy the use has been, and you move straight into the residential program afterwards.
CFHH is situated in Vaughan, Ontario, on 110 acres of serene Canadian countryside with a picturesque lakeside setting.

faqs.q: How far is CFHH from Toronto, and can I visit first?
faqs.a: The centre is about 45 minutes by car from downtown Toronto, at 4360 Kirby Road in Vaughan, York Region. It's roughly 25 minutes from Pearson airport and close to Richmond Hill, Brampton and King City. CFHH offers tours before admission, so you and your family can see the house and a room before you commit.

Every CFHH program includes aftercare, and the Kirby Estate centre provides up to 12 months of it. Your plan is written during your stay and can include individual and group sessions, family therapy, regular check-ins and referrals to professionals near your home.

faqs.q: Is CFHH private? Can I use my benefits?
faqs.a: CFHH is a privately funded centre, and its program is not covered by OHIP or the government. Fees are all-inclusive and payment is due before or on arrival. The intake team can give you an invoice to send to your insurer, so ask your extended health or employer plan whether they will reimburse part of it.

faqs.q: What types of treatments does CFHH offer?
faqs.a: CFHH offers a combination of evidence-based and holistic therapies, focusing on mental health, mindfulness, and overall well-being. Treatments include cognitive-behavioral therapy (CBT), ketamine treatment, medications for opioid recovery, yoga, and psychoeducation.

faqs.q: Is the Centres for Health and Healing a 12-Step program?
faqs.a: No, CFHH employs a non-12-Step approach to treatment, acknowledging that not everyone’s values align with the traditional 12-Step program.

faqs.q: Does CFHH involve family in the treatment process?
faqs.a: Yes, CFHH prioritizes family involvement and offers a family group program every Saturday. They believe that family support, care, and education are essential aspects of lasting recovery.

faqs.q: How does CFHH ensure privacy and security for clients?
faqs.a: CFHH features a gated entrance, which guarantees privacy and security for clients. The secluded property offers a tranquil oasis away from the hustle and bustle of daily life.

Yes, CFHH is a technology-friendly facility, recognizing the needs of working professionals and those with young children. However, they request clients to be technology-free for the first week of their stay, with flexible arrangements available if needed.

faqs.q: What leisure activities are available at CFHH?
faqs.a: Clients can enjoy a range of peaceful activities at CFHH, such as pedal boating on the lake, watching the sunset from the dock, or simply relaxing in the various outdoor seating areas.

faqs.q: What kind of staff does CFHH have?
faqs.a: CFHH’s expert staff includes nurses, counselors, interventionists, case managers, and professional chefs who work together to create personalized and effective treatment plans for each client.
